**Best estimate for 2026-01:** **5,600,000 retail sales units** of **COCA COLA** in Danish retail CSD.

**Estimated range:** **3,800,000–7,800,000 units**  
**Confidence:** **Low-to-moderate, ~40%**

**How I estimated it:**
- Denmark’s 2025 soft-drink market is reported at **966m liters**, with retail/off-trade representing **86% of total soft drinks** and **80% of soda/CSD** volume. ([food.dtu.dk](https://www.food.dtu.dk/english/-/media/institutter/foedevareinstituttet/publikationer/pub-2025/markeds-og-vareundersoegelse-af-energidrikke-i-danmark-final-report.pdf))
- I treated “COCA COLA” as the Coca-Cola trademark brand family in CSD — e.g., Original, Zero Sugar, koffeinfri variants — not all Coca-Cola Company brands like Fanta/Sprite.
- I estimated Danish retail CSD volume at roughly **400–480m liters/year**, Coca-Cola trademark share at roughly **27–31% by volume**, January seasonality at **~6.5–7.0% of annual volume**, and average scanned retail unit size at **~1.4–1.5 liters per sales unit**.
- I adjusted share downward modestly for the 2025 Danish boycott effect, but not dramatically: Carlsberg said in Q1 2025 that Danish Coca-Cola volumes were “slightly down,” while in Q1 2026 it said the Danish/Finnish Coke portfolio was growing again. ([carlsberggroup.com](https://www.carlsberggroup.com/reports-downloads/q1-2025-conference-call-transcript/?utm_source=openai))
- The main uncertainty is the definition of “unit”: I’m forecasting **scanned retail sales units/packages**, not individual cans/bottles inside multipacks. If you mean individual containers, the estimate would be materially higher.
